description_for_human: Discover, price, hire, and verify real-world physical capability — 3D printing, CNC, lab, couriers — via agents.
description_for_model: PCC (Physical Capability Cloud) exposes real-world physical capabilities as agent-callable operations: discover capability types, get build options and prices, build contracts, submit and track jobs, and inspect on-chain-anchored evidence. Use the OpenAPI document for the operationId-named REST surface, the MCP server for a tool transport, and the A2A agent card for agent-to-agent tasks.
